import json,math,csv
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,date,timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path(__file__).parent;ET=ZoneInfo('America/New_York')
data=json.loads((ROOT/'SKHY_daily_completed_2026-10-13.json').read_text());cs=json.loads((ROOT/'contracts.json').read_text())
rates={r['observation_date']:float(r['DGS1MO'])/100 for r in csv.DictReader((ROOT/'iv_rates.csv').open()) if r['DGS1MO'] not in ['','.']}
hist={}
for c in cs:
 if c.get('shares_per_contract')!=100 or c.get('exercise_style')!='american':continue
 raw=json.loads((ROOT/'bars'/(c['ticker'].replace(':','_')+'.json')).read_text())
 hist[c['ticker']]={datetime.fromtimestamp(b['t']/1000,ET).date().isoformat():b for b in raw['response'].get('results',[])}
def tree(S,K,T,r,sigma,side,n=120,q=0):
 dt=T/n;u=np.exp(sigma*np.sqrt(dt));dn=1/u;p=(np.exp((r-q)*dt)-dn)/(u-dn);disc=math.exp(-r*dt)
 j=np.arange(n+1);spots=S*np.exp(np.log(u)[:,None]*(2*j-n));v=np.maximum(side[:,None]*(spots-K[:,None]),0)
 delta=None
 for i in range(n-1,-1,-1):
  v=disc*(p[:,None]*v[:,1:]+(1-p[:,None])*v[:,:-1]);spots=S*np.exp(np.log(u)[:,None]*(2*np.arange(i+1)-i));v=np.maximum(v,side[:,None]*(spots-K[:,None]))
  if i==1:delta=(v[:,1]-v[:,0])/(S*(u-dn))
 return v[:,0],delta

def invert(S,K,T,r,prices,side,n=120,q=0):
 lo=np.full(len(K),.02);hi=np.full(len(K),3.0)
 plo,_=tree(S,K,T,r,lo,side,n,q);phi,_=tree(S,K,T,r,hi,side,n,q)
 valid=(prices>plo+1e-5)&(prices<phi-1e-5)
 for i in range(25):
  mid=(lo+hi)/2;pm,_=tree(S,K,T,r,mid,side,n,q);below=pm<prices;lo=np.where(below,mid,lo);hi=np.where(below,hi,mid)
 sig=(lo+hi)/2;fit,delta=tree(S,K,T,r,sig,side,n,q)
 valid &= np.abs(fit-prices)<.0001
 return sig,delta,valid,float(np.max(np.abs(fit[valid]-prices[valid]))) if valid.any() else None

def interp(points,x):
 pts=sorted(points)
 for a,v in pts:
  if abs(a-x)<1e-10:return v,[[a,v]]
 for (a,v),(b,w) in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
  if a<x<b:return v+(w-v)*(x-a)/(b-a),[[a,v],[b,w]]
 return None,None
proofs=[];rejects=0;fits=[];convergence=[]
for row in data['rows']:
 if row['row_type']!='completed_US_session':continue
 day=row['date'];S=row['stock_close'];rate_day=max(d for d in rates if d<day);r=math.log1p(rates[rate_day]);exps=sorted(set(c['expiration_date'] for c in cs if 0<(date.fromisoformat(c['expiration_date'])-date.fromisoformat(day)).days<=65))
 wanted=set()
 for target in [7,30]:
  lower=[e for e in exps if (date.fromisoformat(e)-date.fromisoformat(day)).days<=target];upper=[e for e in exps if (date.fromisoformat(e)-date.fromisoformat(day)).days>=target]
  if lower:wanted.update(lower[-2:] if target==30 else lower[-1:])
  if upper:wanted.update(upper[:2] if target==30 else upper[:1])
 curves=[]
 for exp in sorted(wanted):
  T=(date.fromisoformat(exp)-date.fromisoformat(day)).days/365
  cand=[]
  for c in cs:
   if c['expiration_date']!=exp or c['ticker'] not in hist or not .70*S<=c['strike_price']<=1.35*S:continue
   b=hist[c['ticker']].get(day)
   if not b or b['v']<10 or b['c']<=0:continue
   side=1 if c['contract_type']=='call' else -1
   if b['c']<=max(side*(S-c['strike_price']),0)+.005:continue
   cand.append((c,b,side))
  if not cand:continue
  K=np.array([c['strike_price'] for c,b,s in cand]);price=np.array([b['c'] for c,b,s in cand]);side=np.array([s for c,b,s in cand])
  sig,delta,valid,fit=invert(S,K,T,r,price,side);rejects+=int((~valid).sum());fits.append(fit)
  out={'expiry':exp,'DTE':T*365,'contracts':[]}
  for i,(c,b,s) in enumerate(cand):
   if not valid[i]:continue
   out['contracts'].append({'ticker':c['ticker'],'side':c['contract_type'],'strike':float(K[i]),'price':float(price[i]),'volume':b['v'],'iv':float(sig[i]),'delta':float(delta[i])})
  for kind in ['put','call']:
   pts=[(abs(c['delta']),c['iv']) for c in out['contracts'] if c['side']==kind and 0<abs(c['delta'])<.5 and (c['strike']<S if kind=='put' else c['strike']>S)]
   out[kind+'_25delta'],out[kind+'_selection']=interp(pts,.25)
  paired={}
  for c in out['contracts']:paired.setdefault(c['strike'],{})[c['side']]=c
  ks=[k for k,v in paired.items() if 'put' in v and 'call' in v and abs(k/S-1)<.03]
  if ks:
   k=min(ks,key=lambda k:abs(k-S));out['atm_strike']=k;out['atm_mean']=sum(paired[k][s]['iv'] for s in ['put','call'])/2
  else:out['atm_mean']=None
  curves.append(out)
  if day in ['2026-08-18','2026-10-12']:
   sig2,_,val2,_=invert(S,K,T,r,price,side,n=240)
   good=valid&val2
   convergence.append({'date':day,'expiry':exp,'contracts':int(good.sum()),'max_120_240_difference_pp':float(np.max(abs(sig[good]-sig2[good]))*100) if good.any() else None})
 p={'date':day,'spot':S,'rate_reference_date':rate_day,'rate_continuous':r,'q_assumption':0,'curves':curves,'term_proofs':{}}
 for term,field,key in [(7,'put_25delta','put_iv7'),(7,'call_25delta','call_iv7'),(7,'atm_mean','atm_iv7'),(30,'atm_mean','atm_iv30')]:
  v,proof=interp([(c['DTE']/365,c[field]**2*c['DTE']/365) for c in curves if c[field] is not None],term/365)
  row[key]=math.sqrt(v/(term/365)) if v is not None else None;p['term_proofs'][key]=proof
 row['iv_source']='American CRR120 model estimate from daily last trades, not provider historical IV';row['iv_rate_date']=rate_day
 for key,a,b in [('skew7_pp','put_iv7','call_iv7'),('iv7_minus_rv5_pp','atm_iv7','rv5'),('iv7_minus_iv30_pp','atm_iv7','atm_iv30')]:row[key]=(row[a]-row[b])*100 if row[a] is not None and row[b] is not None else None
 proofs.append(p)
 print(day,'put',None if row['put_iv7'] is None else round(row['put_iv7']*100,2),'call',None if row['call_iv7'] is None else round(row['call_iv7']*100,2),flush=True)
method={'model':'American Cox-Ross-Rubinstein binomial,120 steps; volatility inversion by 25 bisections, root [2%,300%] annualized','price':'same-day option aggregate c, not synchronized NBBO; same-day stock close; stock-option timing basis may dominate error','filters':'standard100 shares,American,volume>=10,positive price above intrinsic,0.70<=K/S<=1.35;25delta uses strictly OTM valid deltas;ATM common strike within3%spot','rates':'FRED DGS1MO latest observation strictly BEFORE trade date; continuous log(1+yield);latest feed observation2026-10-08 carried forward, no same-day hindsight','dividends':'q=0 modeling assumption. Massive dividend reference returned200 but no SKHY records; absence is not proof of zero dividends. Unknown future dividends and ADR fees not modeled. Do not equate estimates to official IV.','delta':'CRR first-layer hedge ratio; IV interpolated versus abs(delta) to25delta','tenor':'interpolate total variance to7/30 calendar days; expiration16:00ET,valuation16:00ET,no extrapolation','convergence_checks':convergence,'max_fit_error_USD':max(f for f in fits if f is not None),'rejected_root_contracts':rejects,'coverage':{k:sum(row[k] is not None for row in data['rows'] if row['row_type']=='completed_US_session') for k in ['put_iv7','call_iv7','atm_iv7','atm_iv30']}}
data['historical_IV']=method
(ROOT/'iv_estimation_proofs.json').write_text(json.dumps({'method':method,'daily_proofs':proofs},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
(ROOT/'daily_with_estimated_iv.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('COVERAGE',method['coverage'],'CONVERGENCE',convergence,flush=True)
